 First Alert Forecast: Wet and windy weather all week 
 Next country swell on Tuesday 
 Expect leeward sunshine and windward/mauka showers with breezy trade winds all week. Both wind and wet will increase Friday through Sunday. By Dan Cooke Published : Nov. 17, 2026 at 5:39 PM HST | Updated : 7 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google HONOLULU (HawaiiNewsNow) - This breezy trade wind weather is staying a bit longer. Expect winds in the 20-25 mph range all week with an increase in wind speeds through the weekend. Showers are mainly windward and mauka, but spreading leeward at times. The frequency of showers will increase with the winds over the weekend.
 Surf is down all around and will continue to be small until the next country swell on Tuesday.
